title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from the remains of fallen Titans.
pitch: Dive into real-time tactical combat as a surviving Titan core, maneuvering a mech to dismantle enemies and salvage components. Your choices define your power and identity in a cold yet vibrant Titan interior.
coreLoop: Players read enemy intentions, evade or interrupt attacks, target subsystems for dismantling, and make critical decisions on salvaged components to enhance their capabilities.

mechanics.name: Read and Evade
mechanics.description: Players must observe enemy telegraphs and react by dodging or interrupting their attacks in real-time.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Players can choose which subsystem of an enemy to target, affecting the outcome of the combat and the types of components that can be salvaged.

mechanics.name: Dismantle and Decide
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, players face a three-way decision to install, secure, or dismantle salvageable components for various benefits.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, E for interaction
controls.mouse: Aim with mouse, click to target and activate decisions

artDirection.backgroundFx: silhouetted background machinery echoing the Titan interior

difficulty.start: Introduction of a single enemy with simple attack patterns.
difficulty.progression: Enemies become slightly more complex with varied attack patterns, but manageable.
difficulty.peak: Players face a critical moment where their choices significantly affect combat difficulty.

winLose.win: Secure enough components and extract successfully from the arena.
winLose.lose: Failing to outmaneuver the enemy leads to defeat and loss of salvage.

juice.screenShake: when dodging significant enemy attacks or during dismantling
juice.particles: when dismantling an enemy or installing a component
juice.flash: when a subsystem is successfully preserved for salvage

scopeNotes: Do NOT build procedural dungeons, economy/shop, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, crafting, upgrades between runs, narrative scenes, or save systems.

scoreEvents: score increases from successful evasion, subsystem targeting, component installation, and extraction outcomes
